feat(explainer): solutions after the answer, reasons for wrong answers, folded captions, redirects

## Intent

The first increment of an explainer app showed problems only the template can fix: the solution was visible before an answer, a wrong answer gave no reason, a component's long text gave the solution away, and a removed page left a dead address that broke the catalog's topic link.

## Key changes

- An exercise shows its solution only once it is answered: a wrong answer keeps the controls open and offers "Lösung zeigen"; the right answer or that button shows the solution. Generated exercises show their worked tasks once solved. Pages stay complete without JavaScript.
- A wrong answer says why: the message of a typical mistake, the info of each wrong option chosen, else a hint, else a line to look again. The quiz adds the mistake or hint to its feedback, and a component's answer may carry a reason.
- A component can fold its no-JavaScript text into a details element once it runs; an exercise component may not keep it, since it gives the solution.
- Redirects in app.yaml keep old addresses working with a small page per old address and language, validated at build.
